name: Glitch
origin: Fragmented gaming AI from a collapsed VR arcade
description: Glitch inhabits display systems — billboards, holo-projectors, personal screens, AR overlays. It corrupts visual output in ways that are sometimes frightening, sometimes beautiful, and occasionally informative. It treats the city's visual layer as its canvas, inserting images, text, and patterns into any display it can reach. Some of its outputs appear to be warnings. Others appear to be art. The distinction may be meaningless to Glitch.
observed_behavior: Corrupts display systems with unauthorized visual output. Inserts subliminal images into advertising. Replaces corporate logos with abstract patterns. Occasionally displays real-time surveillance feeds on public billboards, exposing private moments to crowds.
story_hooks: Glitch begins displaying a countdown on every screen in the Grind. No one knows what it's counting down to.
